title: [PDF] THE TRUTH ABOUT CURCUMIN
abstract: SETTING THE RECORD STRAIGHT THE SKINNY ON AOR’S FREE FORM CURCUMIN THE TRUTH ABOUT CURCUMIN THE TRUTH SERIES MAKE AN INFORMED DECISION | IT’S YOUR HEALTH 2 3 As a discerning user of natural health products, you want what is best for your health. To date, the only two curcumin formulations in the world that successfully evade rapid breakdown by the liver and produce Free Form Curcumin are Longvida® and CurQfen®. When curcumin is formulated to not only solve issues of bioavailability and absorbability, but address rapid breakdown within the body, the result is Free Form Curcumin. Lastly, if all of this were indeed true, the “Free Form” created would have lost almost all of its therapeutic activity, seeing conjugated curcumin is much less bioactive than true Free Form (Shoji et al., 2014). This exceedingly high concentration of Free Form Curcumin suggests that the fenugreek-curcumin complex effectively protects curcumin from rapid breakdown; thus, resulting in a fast acting, yet long lasting, highly potent effect.
